question: Which Indian Mass Movement began with the famous ‘Dandi March’ of Mahatma Gandhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Civil Disobedience Movement**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Civil Disobedience Movement** was initiated by Mahatma Gandhi in 1930.
 
• The movement began with the famous **Dandi March**, where Gandhi and his followers marched to the Arabian Sea to produce salt from seawater, defying the British salt tax.
 
• This movement was a pivotal part of the Indian independence struggle and aimed at resisting British rule through nonviolent means.
 
• The Dandi March covered a distance of approximately 240 miles from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi, Gujarat.
 
• The movement saw widespread participation from various sections of Indian society, including women, students, and peasants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Non-Cooperation Movement** was launched by Gandhi in 1920 but was called off in 1922 after the Chauri Chaura incident.
 
• The **Quit India Movement** was started in 1942, demanding an end to British rule in India.
 
• The **Kheda Movement** was a peasant struggle in 1918 led by Gandhi in the Kheda district of Gujarat.
 
• The **Dandi March** and the subsequent Civil Disobedience Movement marked a significant escalation in the Indian struggle for independence.
